parts.name: Container
parts.description: interactive surface that carries intent styling, padding, and the focus ring

parts.name: Label
parts.description: caller-supplied text describing the action; the accessible name

parts.name: Leading icon (optional)
parts.description: decorative or semantic hint anchored before the label

parts.name: Trailing icon (optional)
parts.description: affordance hint after the label (caret, external-link, arrow)

parts.name: Loading spinner (optional)
parts.description: replaces or augments the label during async work; pairs with disabled-like styling

patterns.note: hover, focus, and active feedback use the shared interaction-motion timing (see `foundations/dist/interaction-motion.json`); transitions affect background, border, and elevation, not layout

requirements.title: Keyboard operability
requirements.body: every action is reachable and activatable from keyboard; buttons fire on Enter and Space, links on Enter

requirements.title: Focus visible
requirements.body: focus ring meets 3:1 contrast against the surrounding surface; never remove the outline without an equivalent indicator

requirements.title: Accessible name
requirements.body: icon-only actions require `aria-label` or visually hidden text; the name describes the action, not the icon

requirements.title: Color independence
requirements.body: destructive, disabled, and active states are not signaled by color alone; pair with icon, text, or border treatment

requirements.title: Loading-state announcement
requirements.body: async actions expose progress via `aria-busy` or a live-region status; the visible spinner alone is not sufficient for assistive tech

requirements.title: Link-vs-button semantics
requirements.body: use `<button>` for actions and `<a href>` for navigation; do not style one as the other without correcting the underlying role
